pull.title: Superseded by #16: reasoning stream status (not encrypted-token telemetry)
pull.body:
Superseded by [PR #16](https://git.n3t.work/vith/oh-my-pi/pulls/16), which uses the accurate name **reasoning stream status**. The obsolete feature branch has been removed.

## What

Show the existing thinking pulse as soon as summary-less reasoning starts and display time since the last assistant-stream update, including ANSI and native terminal paths. Reveal ticks and repaints do not reset that age.

## Why

Make observable stream state and silence visible. This does not expose encrypted tokens, prove continued inference, or distinguish silent inference from a stalled request. The original feature branch name was misleading.

## Testing

- Reproduced the missing summary-less pulse before the fix.
- 53 focused source tests passed after integration; changed-file oxlint passed.
- Real tmux TUI smoke observed the row during silence and removal when answer text appeared. Native protocol tests cover redraw age, source-update reset, and answer transition.
- Earlier source no-emit checks passed. Remote pipeline #132 failed formatting before compilation; the correction and final build are tracked in #16.
- No local compilation. CI test suites disabled by existing policy. CHANGELOG unchanged because not requested.

---

- [ ] `bun check` passes
- [x] Tested locally
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated with the required attribution (if user-facing; internal issue fixes use issue links, external contributions add the PR link and contributor credit after creation)
